subject: RE: Request for subprocessor inventory & evidence — Nimbus supply chain review
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood-inference.com
Cc: procurement@nimbus-analytics.com
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Request for subprocessor inventory & CAIQ answers for vendor review

Hi Olga,

We're kicking off the supply-chain review for vendors supporting Nimbus Analytics. Could you please provide: 1) a current subprocessor inventory (name, purpose, regions where they process data), 2) a copy or link to your latest SOC 2 Type II attestation, and 3) a brief CAIQ / CAIQ-lite response or pointer to where we can see your answers?

We have a short review timeline — would appreciate the inventory and SOC2 by EOD Monday so we can progress to our procurement risk team. If you have a redacted pen-test exec summary we can include, that would be helpful.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Supply Chain Risk — Nimbus Analytics
liam.oconnor@nimbus-analytics.com
(Attachment: Nimbus_Risk_Request_Template.xlsx)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com, mina.haddad@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Request for subprocessor inventory & CAIQ answers for vendor review

Hi Liam — thanks for the note and the template. We're happy to help. We can provide: 1) our current subprocessor inventory CSV, 2) a secure link to our SOC 2 Type II report under NDA, and 3) a CAIQ-lite checklist we've prepared for customer reviews. Attaching the inventory CSV.

A couple of things I wanted to call out up front so your reviewers have context:
- We use multiple subprocessors for observability and metrics ingestion; those services only receive aggregated telemetry and are not used for PII.
- For model serving we rely on our dedicated on-prem offering for regulated customers; the hosted service uses a set of CDN/cache and inference runtimes — names are in the CSV.
- We have EU data-processing controls and contractual SCCs for subprocessors in the EU.

Next steps: if Nimbus needs the SOC 2 PDF we can share via a secure link (we redact customer IDs). I'll coordinate with Vivek and Mina for the pen-test summary and the CAIQ-lite answers.

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Head of Trust & Vendor Risk
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood_subprocessor_inventory_202602.csv)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimbus-analytics.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood-inference.com
Cc: procurement@nimbus-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 08:33:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Request for subprocessor inventory & CAIQ answers for vendor review

Thanks Olga — that inventory helps. A few clarifying questions from our risk team after a quick pass:
1) For the observability vendor listed (TelemetryFlux), can you confirm whether logs are retained longer than 90 days and whether they receive any request/response bodies?
2) For the model artifacts storage (ModelStoreX), do you use customer-specific encryption keys (BYOK) or platform-managed keys?
3) Do any subprocessors process data in APAC in a way that would subject us to local data residency rules?

If you can answer inline that would speed our review.

Also — procurement asked whether Redwood can accept Nimbus' standard Data Processing Addendum. We can loop that in once the risk review is complete.

Best,
Liam

> On 2 Mar 2026, at 09:18, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood-inference.com> wrote:
> > Attaching the inventory CSV.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood-inference.com, mina.haddad@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 10:42:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Request for subprocessor inventory & CAIQ answers for vendor review

Hi Liam — Vivek from Infra/Platform here. Quick answers to your three points: 
1) TelemetryFlux: we send only metrics and structured logs (no raw request/response bodies). Log retention is configurable per customer; default retention is 30 days for hosted plans and 90 days for Dedicated customers. We can apply 90-day retention for Nimbus if required.
2) ModelStoreX: platform-managed keys in hosted; we offer customer-managed keys (KMS) for our Dedicated and Private deployments. For Nimbus' hosted org we currently use platform keys, but we can enable BYOK for Dedicated/Private.
3) APAC processing: a small subset of our CDN and monitoring subprocessors have edge nodes in APAC for latency optimization. Those nodes only handle ephemeral cache and aggregated telemetry; we do not route customer PII through APAC nodes by default. If Nimbus has strict residency requirements we can disable APAC edge routing for your tenancy.

I've uploaded our SOC 2 Type II link and a redacted pen-test executive summary for procurement to review: https://redwood.app/secure-share/nimbus-evidence-2391 (expires in 30 days).

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood-soc2-type2-2025.pdf (secure link))
(Attachment: redwood-pen-test-summary-2025.pdf)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@nimbus-analytics.com>
Cc: olga.petrov@redwood-inference.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood-inference.com, evelyn.hart@redwood-inference.com
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2026 16:27:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request for subprocessor inventory & CAIQ answers for vendor review

Hi Liam — Mina from Security & Compliance following up. A few additional notes for your CAIQ reviewers: 
- We maintain a rolling annual penetration test and have a third-party assessor for external network and application testing. The attached exec summary covers the latest engagement and is redacted to remove customer identifiers.
- Change management, code review, and deploy controls are documented in our public security whitepaper; link included in our secure share.
- For subprocessors we use a risk-based intake: higher-risk vendors (access to customer plaintext or private keys) require SOC2/ISO27001 and an annual review. Lower-risk vendors are covered by contractual controls and quarterly monitoring.

If Nimbus would like, we can provide a CAIQ-lite spreadsheet with row-level answers mapped to your risk questionnaire. Let us know and we'll return that within 48 hours.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: redwood-pen-test-summary-2025.pdf)
